name: Thracian Tomb of Kazanlak
description: This beehive-shaped brick tomb near the town of Kazanlak in central Bulgaria was built around 2,300 years ago and found by chance in 1944. A short corridor leads to a small round chamber covered in colourful paintings of Thracian funeral rites. They are the best-preserved Hellenistic paintings in Bulgaria, set among over a thousand burial mounds in the Valley of the Thracian Rulers.
